name: EPW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Established for Black Dawn (2004), the promotion's own first pay-per-view. The title history document itself (fwrestling.com forum 342) carries the reign line through a 2014 hiatus; reigns are recorded here only through 14 November 2009.

name: EPW Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Established for Black Dawn (2004) alongside the World Heavyweight Championship. The title history document itself carries the reign line through a 2013 hiatus; reigns are recorded here only through 14 November 2009.

name: EPW Television Championship
epitaph: Created April-May 2005 per the fed's own announcement and first awarded by tournament at Black Dawn 2005. The title history document itself carries the reign line through a 2013 hiatus; reigns are recorded here only through 14 November 2009.

name: EPW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Established for Black Dawn (2004) alongside the World Heavyweight and Intercontinental Championships. The title history document itself carries the reign line through a 2014 hiatus; reigns are recorded here only through 14 November 2009.
